notes: Verified this session: kobuki#136 (title 'Battery charge not shown in Android apps', empty body, corot 2012-06-20) and comment 6444016 verbatim (both fix changes plus the NOTES explaining the hard-coded 3.14 A / 2.2 Ah values); the bb3c7ec patch verbatim (diagnostics.yaml adds 'remove_prefix: mobile_base' to each analyzer; diagnostics.cpp key-value changes exactly as quoted, plus 'Current (A)' 3.14/0.0 branches).
